'''Shana Goridien''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]].{{Ref/book|6|40}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
She has bulging eyes and reminds [[Elayne]] of a fish. She always looks startled, although she normally maintains a deep reserve.

==Strength and Abilities==
Shana is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|41}}. We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She matches [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength level after she was [[Healed]] for her [[stilling]].

Although weak in the One Power, she is an expert at reading residues.{{Ref/book|10|19}} 

== History ==
Shana is 118 years old. She was born in {{ne|882}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|898}}. After spending eleven years as a [[novice]] and nine years as [[Accepted]], Shana was raised to the shawl in {{ne|918}}.

==Activities==
She has joined with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].{{Ref/book|6|40}}

Shana was one of the Aes Sedai that cornered [[Aviendha]] when she arrived in Salidar and who wanted to put her in novice white.

She is part of the group that is sent to where the [[Cleansing of saidin|Cleansing of ''saidin'']] occurred, because they are expert at reading residues.{{Ref/book|10|16}} Some time after they report that they found a large hole where [[Shadar Logoth]] used to be.{{Ref/book|10|19}}
